name: The Ocean Race Atlantic 2026 — Virtual
description: Fantasy edition of The Ocean Race Atlantic: New York to Lorient, ~3,200 nm across the North Atlantic, first 50/50 gender-parity fully-crewed transatlantic race, sailed by the IMOCA fleet. Virtual start 14:00 UTC 2 Sep — the real gun, postponed from the planned start while the fleet cleared the marine-mammal go-slow areas out of New York. Exclusion zones (drawn red on the map) drag virtual boats to half speed inside. Polar: legacy (non-foiling) IMOCA 60 at 95% — the real foilers will be faster; the virtual fleet all sails the same numbers. Route yourself across: great circle vs. ridge-dodging is the whole game.
